messages:
Mae CSM: Heads up — TenantWave (Enterprise, 6/30 renewal) flagged as low-engagement after onboarding. Weekly active users 1-2, key power users not logging in. Need a quick save plan + one-shot survey to diagnose. Thoughts?

Jorge Onboarding: yikes. Do we have the onboarding completion score & which milestones failed?

Mae CSM: completion shows ~85% but usage is almost entirely embeddings/ingest. No prompt templates or reranking used. CS check-ins missed last 2 weeks (outreach unanswered).

Anita RevOps: risk estimate: ~30% chance to renew if we don't intervene. Proposed immediate steps: 1) 60m targeted enablement workshop for power users, 2) 2-week tailored success path with 3 milestones, 3) short 3-question feedback survey to capture blockers + desired outcomes.

Rohit Support: can run a quick health-check + permissions audit. Also will look for any console/errors that would explain dropoff. Pinging infra for quota logs.

Mae CSM: Proposed workshop slot: Tue 10am PT. Who can lead the product demo and a short prompt-tuning segment? @Rohit for troubleshooting / logs?

Jorge Onboarding: I can lead templates + prompt tuning. I'll own the post-workshop checklist and follow-ups.

Anita RevOps: Draft survey (3 Qs) — please review before I send:
messages_2:
1) What stopped you from using [feature X]?
2) What outcome would make you renew?
3) Any blockers we can remove?
Survey link: https://forms.redwood.example/tenantwave-risk

Mae CSM: Pasted survey in the customer record and #cs-handbook channel for audit. Suggest incentive: 30-min consult + $500 platform credit for responses from admins.

Rohit Support: Quick snippet for gathering client usage/logs if needed:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage/clients/tenantwave | jq .
```
I'll prepare step-by-step access instructions.

enablement-bot: Assigned tasks — Workshop owner: Jorge Onboarding; Survey send: Anita RevOps; Health-check: Rohit Support. Reminder set for 48h.

Mae CSM: Thanks all :pray: I'll loop in the AE for renewal strategy and add this to the account board: https://trello.com/c/abc123

Jorge Onboarding: Confirmed — I'll send invites + attendee prep doc today.

Anita RevOps: Sending survey EOD. Will report back with results and recommended next actions by 1755554389.
notes: thread focuses on enablement coordination, feedback capture, and a short churn-save play for an at-risk renewal
